title: During the import process, 3D components (GLB and FBX) are imported from the last import point, but the editor freezes and becomes unresponsive.
body:
### Tested versions

Godot 4.5.1.stable

Issue observed consistently on first reimport

First import works correctly

Issue reproducible across multiple projects

Important:  
The issue does NOT occur in brand-new clean projects initially.  
It starts appearing after working in an existing project and then affects reimports and even normal imports.

(Older versions not tested yet; can be tested if required.)

---

### System information

OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)  
CPU: Intel Core i5-10200H  
GPU: NVIDIA GTX 1650 (Mobile, 4 GB VRAM)  
RAM: 16 GB  
Renderer: Vulkan (Forward+)  

Security software:  
Windows Defender (real-time protection enabled by default)  
Windows Firewall enabled by default  

Important:  
Disabling Windows Defender real-time protection and Windows Firewall does NOT resolve the issue.  
The editor freeze still occurs during import and reimport even when all Windows security features are fully disabled.

---

### Issue description

When importing 3D assets (GLB or FBX) into Godot 4.5.1, the first import completes successfully.  
However, after working on a project for some time, importing or reimporting 3D assets causes the Godot editor to freeze during the final import stage.

This affects:
- Reimporting previously imported assets
- Importing completely new assets into the same project

Key characteristics:

- Texture import completes successfully  
- Freeze occurs at the final mesh processing / finalization stage  
- Editor becomes unresponsive (Not Responding)  
- CPU usage stabilizes around 55–60%, not maxed out  
- No crash log is produced  
- Waiting indefinitely does not resolve the freeze  

Importantly:

- This issue occurs with both GLB and FBX  
- Blender export settings, materials, and textures remain unchanged  
- Textures are small (≤2K, few in number)  
- Deleting the .import folder does NOT resolve the issue  
- Deleting the .godot folder does NOT resolve the issue  
- The issue persists even when importing completely new assets after these folders are deleted  

---

### Expected behavior

- Importing or reimporting 3D assets should always complete successfully  
- The editor should remain responsive  
- Import behavior should be consistent within the same project  

---

### Actual behavior

- Editor freezes indefinitely during the final import stage  
- Godot must be force-closed  
- The issue persists once it starts occurring in a project  

---

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new Godot 4.5.1 project  
2. Import a simple 3D model (GLB or FBX)  
   → Import completes successfully  
3. Continue working in the same project (importing, reimporting, editing assets)  
4. At some point, import or reimport any 3D asset  
5. Observe the editor freezing during the final import stage  

---

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A  
The issue does not reproduce immediately in a clean project, but appears after some time working in the same project.

---

### Additional notes

- The issue is not related to texture size, count, or format  
- The issue is not caused by Blender export setting changes  
- The issue is not resolved by:
  - Deleting the .import folder  
  - Deleting the .godot folder  
  - Recreating assets  
- Once triggered in a project, the issue affects both reimports and new imports  

---

### Summary

This appears to be a project-state–dependent editor freeze occurring during the final stage of 3D asset import and reimport (GLB and FBX) on Windows.  
Once triggered, the issue persists within the project and significantly disrupts asset iteration and development workflow.

!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!NOTE!!!!!!!!!!!: My project's .godot->imported folder has 3600 import entries. The .import folder has around 600. Yes, that's a bit much, but Godot freezing is really strange. Additionally: deleting the .import or .godot folder also freeze the editor during the final reimport phase of normal assets.
